changelog: - **Japanese text is no longer drawn bold everywhere.** On a computer with the Noto Sans JP font installed in its Bold weight only, every Japanese letter in the menus, the lists, the canvas and the side panels was drawn bold, whatever weight it was meant to have. The interface named Noto Sans JP first among its Japanese fonts. It now names the system's own Japanese fonts first (Hiragino Sans on macOS, Yu Gothic UI, Yu Gothic and Meiryo on Windows), which have every weight, and keeps Noto Sans JP for systems without them. Other languages are unchanged.
